$comment: Curated tileset catalog read by the in-app Regions browser. Each entry must have id/name/description/url/sizeBytes; `schema` is "openmaptiles" or "protomaps" (absent = openmaptiles) and decides which bundled style draws it. url should be a stable direct download (e.g. a GitHub Release asset under DazedDingo/trail's `tilesets-v1` release) - the file name the download lands under is the URL's last path segment, so keep the .pmtiles/.mbtiles extension right. Add or remove entries here and the next app launch picks them up.
